items.title: Drag, and it opens
items.body: Drop AntiChat on Applications in the installer and it installs and opens by itself.

items.title: Chat waits for its model
items.body: Setup opens the chat only once a text model can answer.

items.title: Shows up in Apps
items.body: After installing, AntiChat appears in Apps and Spotlight right away.

items.title: Pause and resume work
items.body: A paused download now shows Resume and picks up where it stopped. Turning off a pack with nothing downloaded just turns it off.
